ns2:section.sectionText: This course is meant for students with an interest in graduate school and will cover areas such as application preparation, letters of recommendation, research, writing, and other relevant topics. Speakers, including some on-campus admissions personnel and current graduate students will present. The course is most relevant to students continuing into research-based programs, although students going into professional, law, and medical programs may also be interested. ***Students must submit a form of interest in order to be given permission to register for the course. Sign-up here: http://go.economics.illinois.edu/198GradSchool
